## Où j'en suis
Prepared the PostgreSQL 17 blue/green upgrade for the analytics RDS: parameter group family is now derived from the major version, blue/green is enabled on staging (16.4 → 17.2), prod is prepared behind `pg17_enabled = false`, the AWS provider is pinned to `~> 5.82.0`, tflint is clean, and draft PR kestrel-analytics/infra#57 is open. Nothing has been applied — plan only, per instruction.

- [en-cours] Draft PR open, awaiting review and Maya's sign-off before any prod date is set.
- [prochaine-étape] Upgrade pg_partman 4.7.4 → 5.1.0 on staging 16.4 (ALTER EXTENSION, then check run_maintenance_proc on events_raw/events_daily) before any staging apply.
- [prochaine-étape] Pick a prod window after Maya signs off, avoiding the dbt lock on events_daily (01:00–03:30 UTC).
- [essai-raté] Provider v6 (unpinned init -upgrade) pulled in unrelated breaking changes (S3 ACL, aws_eip.vpc) — rejected, pinned to 5.82.
- [décision] No prod date until Maya signs off; apply_immediately stays false on prod (source: t14).
- [décision] AWS provider pinned to 5.82, no v6 in this PR (source: t04).
